items.subject: Study Strategy
items.body: **The 2-3-7 Spaced Revision Framework**: Review challenging derivations 2 days after first learning, test via blank sheet active recall on Day 3, and solve past 5-year board questions on Day 7.

items.subject: Physics
items.body: **4-Day Physics Electromagnetism Sprint**: Day 1: Electrostatics Gauss Law & Dipole derivations; Day 2: Kirchhoff laws & potentiometer problems; Day 3: Biot-Savart & Ampere loop problems; Day 4: AC generator & LCR resonance numericals.
